name: Sara Fernandez
role: Senior Data Engineer | Technical Lead | Data Architecture
typing: Architecting and building enterprise data platforms
tagline: I architect, build, and scale enterprise data platforms, taking technical ownership from design and implementation to production deployment, performance optimization, and operational reliability.
about: Senior Data Engineer and Technical Lead at AGCO, with 15 years of software engineering experience and five years specializing in data engineering. I developed the South America Data Lineage platform from the ground up and authored the initial technical assessment for migrating our legacy AWS data stack to Databricks on GCP.

I design and implement enterprise data platforms, distributed processing pipelines, and analytics solutions across cloud and on-premises environments. My expertise spans data architecture, integration, modeling, batch and incremental processing, governance, lineage, quality, and observability.

I take end-to-end technical ownership, from solution architecture and implementation through production deployment, performance optimization, and operational reliability. I focus on maintainable systems, reproducible execution, and clear operational ownership.

My background in enterprise software and financial systems gives me a strong understanding of business processes. I apply that experience to data engineering, building reliable solutions aligned with operational and business requirements.
I also mentor engineers, onboard technical talent, and contribute to engineering team development through documentation, technical training, and knowledge transfer.

highlights.title: Selected engineering achievements
highlights.lead: Enterprise data platforms and engineering initiatives I have designed, implemented or led.

items.title: South America Data Lineage Platform
items.text: Designed, implemented, documented and deployed an end-to-end data lineage platform for South America, connecting metadata across ETL pipelines, Amazon Redshift tables, Tableau assets and business data products to improve operational traceability.

items.title: AWS to Databricks Migration Assessment
items.text: Authored the initial technical assessment for migrating the legacy AWS data stack to Databricks on GCP, evaluating existing platform assets, migration readiness, and architectural considerations for scalability, governance and maintainability.

items.title: Enterprise Data Portal
items.text: Led development of a self-service data platform for governed data access and visibility across business units, integrating Apache Airflow, GCP, Azure, Superset and Power BI.

items.title: Modular extraction platform modernization
items.text: Re-architected a legacy monolithic extraction platform into parameterized, reusable Python components with structured logging, improving maintainability, traceability and operational support.

experience.text: Designed, implemented, documented and deployed the South America Data Lineage platform. Authored the initial technical assessment for migrating the legacy AWS data stack to Databricks on GCP. Develop architecture and modernization strategies for the South America Data Platform, collaborating with global stakeholders to assess migration readiness, inventory platform assets, and establish data product, lineage, cataloging and quality standards.

Translated business requirements across finance, marketing, manufacturing and logistics into ETL specifications and data pipelines. Worked across legacy and modern platforms including Pentaho, Redshift, Rundeck, AWS S3, Databricks, Python, SQL and PySpark, contributing to modularity, observability and governance.

Led development of a self-service data platform for governed access and visibility, integrating Airflow, GCP, Azure, Superset and Power BI. Worked across data delivery, cloud infrastructure and CI/CD to support reliable analytics consumption.

Modernized a legacy ETL architecture into a modular Python-based pipeline with parameterized components, reusable classes and structured logging, improving maintainability, traceability and operational support while exposing curated datasets through REST APIs.

Worked across the ISA-95 stack, connecting industrial systems and data flows from PLC and SCADA environments through MES and analytics. This foundation shaped my systems-oriented approach to data architecture and industrial data platforms.
